_note: Source of truth: docs/puzzle-bible.md. Plant every hiding place in the description. Hidden items (keys, quarter) are not listed here; they start inside a container in items.json.

rooms.name: Basement
rooms.description: A low, damp basement that smells like 1985. A workbench holds a coffee can of pencils, a cassette with its tape pulled out, and a Walkman. Against the wall, a wood-grain Atari console is hooked to a small TV, with a cartridge box beside it. Nearby sit a Simon game, a Magic 8-Ball, a shoebox of baseball cards, a View-Master, and a jar of mismatched batteries. A staircase leads up to a door.

exits.lockedText: The door at the top of the stairs is locked. You will need a key.
exits.passText: The key turns. You climb the stairs into the hallway.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.description: A narrow hallway with a phone table. A rotary phone sits beside an answering machine with a blinking light. Grandpa's pager is clipped to the table's edge. A scrap of paper by the phone reads TELL MOM: NOT MY JACKET. A snapshot of young Dad in a jacket with the collar popped hangs on the wall. The coat closet is slightly ajar, a sleeve showing. There is also a bowl of labeled keys, a Yellow Pages, a Rolodex, an umbrella stand, and a wall calendar stuck on a month in 1987.

exits.lockedText: The basement door is stuck for a moment, then gives.
exits.passText: You head back down to the basement.

exits.lockedText: The bedroom door is locked. You will need a key.
exits.passText: The key turns. You step into a boy's bedroom.

rooms.name: Dad's Boyhood Bedroom
rooms.description: A small bedroom, preserved like a museum. An NES with one controller sits under a TV. A game cartridge rests on the shelf. A toybox has a hand-lettered lid: AUTOBOTS ONLY. DECEPTICONS KEEP OUT. On the wall, a Polaroid shows young Dad holding a big robot trailer like a trophy. A comic lies on the bed. The toybox rattles with a Cabbage Patch Kid, a Rubik's Cube, an Etch A Sketch, a one-armed action figure, a villain robot toy, and something folded and robot-shaped.

exits.lockedText: The door is stuck for a moment, then gives.
exits.passText: You head back to the hallway.

exits.lockedText: The door to the study is locked. You will need a key.
exits.passText: The key turns. You walk into a dim study.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: A dim study that smells of pipe smoke and dust. A hi-fi console holds a turntable with a record on the platter; its cord is nowhere to be seen. A tall bookshelf stands against the wall behind it. On the desk sit a Commodore 64, a floppy disk box, and a sticky note on the monitor: DO NOT TOUCH MY DISKS. A newspaper clipping about a backwards-messages scare, with one paragraph circled, is pinned beside it. Also here: a typewriter, a stack of vinyl, a desk lamp, a globe, and a letter opener.

exits.lockedText: The door is stuck for a moment, then gives.
exits.passText: You head back to the boyhood bedroom.

exits.lockedText: The door to the grandparents' bedroom is locked. You will need a key.
exits.passText: The key turns. You step into a quiet bedroom.

rooms.name: Grandparents' Bedroom
rooms.description: A quiet bedroom with a floral bedspread. A VCR sits under a TV, blinking 12:00. A clock radio on the nightstand is stopped at an odd time. The nightstand drawer holds a scribbled TV listing with SATURDAY circled. A shelf holds an aerobics workout tape case and a Betamax tape. Also here: a ballerina jewelry box, leg warmers, and a tie rack. The front door is just past the foot of the bed.

exits.lockedText: The door is stuck for a moment, then gives.
exits.passText: You head back to the study.

exits.lockedText: The front door is locked. You will need a key.

rooms.name: Outside
rooms.description: Nothing here yet. The ending takes over.
